fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 stores vptr 0x7104f89898 into the 16-byte module (weapon/other class 0x71051af648 same size) and stores the module at boma+0x188.

fields.name: impl (MotionAnimcmd line state, 0x120 bytes)
fields.evidence: Builder allocates a 0x120-byte block right after the module and stores it here; every slot function loads [this+0x8] first and works on that block.

fields.name: impl.owner_boma
fields.evidence: Builder stores the boma at impl+0x0; flush (slot +0x98) reaches boma+0x140 (EffectModule) and boma+0x70 through it; exec_motion_lines_initialize reaches boma+0x88 (MotionModule).

fields.name: impl.current_motion_line_id (the line set the module's agents were built for)
fields.evidence: Initialised to -1 by the builder; the init slot (+0x28) copies it from its argument's +0x9C; compared with the per-category line ids at +0x98..+0xA4 to choose the main (+0x58 array) or the alternate (+0xB8 array) agent; call_script_single treats line == -1 as this value.

fields.name: impl.unused_or_pad (-1)
fields.evidence: High half of the 64-bit -1 the builder stores at +0x8; no reader seen.

fields.name: impl.secondary_line_id
fields.evidence: -1 in the builder; init slot copies its argument's +0xA8 here. Use not traced further.

fields.name: impl.main_motion_kind (requested script motion for the full lines)
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_lines (slot +0x68, f_71006e4c00) stores its Hash40 here; reset to hash40 'invalid' (0x07fb997a80) by the builder, init slot and flush (slot +0x98) after the request is consumed.

fields.name: impl.main_start_frame
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_lines stores its first float here; exec_motion_lines_initialize (slot +0x88) also writes it. Builder 0.0.

fields.name: impl.main_rate
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_lines stores its second float here; builder 1.0; read by exec_motion_lines_initialize when it seeks the agents.

fields.name: impl.main_request_aux (-1)
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_lines writes -1 here; meaning not traced.

fields.name: impl.main_flag_a
fields.evidence: First bool argument of change_script_motion_lines; exec_motion_lines_initialize writes its bool here too.

fields.name: impl.main_flag_b
fields.evidence: Second bool argument of change_script_motion_lines; cleared by exec_motion_lines_initialize.

fields.name: impl.main_flag_c
fields.evidence: Third bool argument of change_script_motion_lines.

fields.name: impl.partial_motion_kind
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_partial_lines (slot +0x70, f_71006e4c90) stores its Hash40 here; reset to 'invalid' by flush.

fields.name: impl.partial_start_frame
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_partial_lines first float.

fields.name: impl.partial_rate
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_partial_lines second float; builder 1.0.

fields.name: impl.partial_request_aux (-1)
fields.evidence: Written -1 by change_script_motion_partial_lines.

fields.name: impl.partial_flag_a
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_partial_lines first bool.

fields.name: impl.partial_flag_b
fields.evidence: change_script_motion_partial_lines second bool.

fields.name: impl.main_frame_delta (frame step the main lines ran this update)
fields.evidence: exec_motion_lines (slot +0x58, f_71006e4ac0) stores max(0, a frame value) and passes it to the agents of categories 0/1; flush_current_motion (f_71006e3970) uses it for categories 2/3 then zeroes it; zeroed when sleeping.

fields.name: impl.partial_frame_delta
fields.evidence: Partial-lines equivalent: slot +0x60 (f_71006e4b80) stores it and runs the +0x78/+0x80 agents; flush_current_motion runs +0x88/+0x90 with it then zeroes it.

fields.name: impl.sleep[0] game
fields.evidence: set_sleep_game (slot +0xA8, f_71006e5330) stores its bool here; exec_motion_lines skips category 0 when set.

fields.name: impl.sleep[1] (expression, probable)
fields.evidence: Tested by exec_motion_lines to skip category 1; no exported setter.

fields.name: impl.sleep[2] sound
fields.evidence: set_sleep_sound (slot +0xB8, f_71006e5350); flush_current_motion skips category 2 when set.

fields.name: impl.sleep[3] effect
fields.evidence: set_sleep_effect (slot +0xB0, f_71006e5340); flush_current_motion skips category 3 when set.

fields.name: impl.main_agent[c] (lua animcmd agent running the main motion's script, per line category c (0..3); c=0 game, c=2 sound, c=3 effect (from set_sleep_game/sound/effect), c=1 by elimination expression (probable))
fields.evidence: Selected when line id [+0x98+4c] equals +0x8; reset slot (+0x50, f_71006e4a40) resets all 12 agents through f_7101f443d0; call_script_single copies agent state blocks (agent+0x1C8..0x25C).

fields.name: impl.partial_agent[c]
fields.evidence: Run by the partial exec slot (+0x60) and flush_current_motion with the partial frame delta.

fields.name: impl.main_line_id[c]
fields.evidence: call_script_single / change_script_motion_line_single write the line id per category; compared with +0x8 to pick +0x58 vs +0xB8 agent. Builder -1.

fields.name: impl.single_line_id[c]
fields.evidence: call_script_single writes +0x8 into both +0x98+4c and +0xA8+4c after releasing the alternate agent's pending object (agent+0x290).

fields.name: impl.alt_agent[c] (agent used when a single script on another line overrides the main one)
fields.evidence: Used instead of +0x58 when the category's line id differs from +0x8; change_script_motion_line_single resets agent fields +0x1C8..0x200 of both +0x58 and +0xB8 agents for the 'invalid' hash.

fields.name: impl.script_lookup_callback
fields.evidence: Slot +0xD8 (f_71006e5390) moves a std::function into impl+0xE0 (32-byte buffer, invoker pointer at +0x100); change_script_motion_line_single calls [+0x100] vtable +0x30 to resolve a script for another line.

fields.name: impl.skip_delay_update
fields.evidence: enable_skip_delay_update (slot +0xC8, f_71006e5370) stores 1; flush_current_motion skips the delayed sound/effect run when set; flush (slot +0x98) clears it.

fields.name: impl.is_sleep
fields.evidence: is_sleep (slot +0xC0, f_71006e5360) returns ld8 impl+0x111; set_sleep (slot +0xA0, f_71006e5320) stores the bool; exec_motion_lines zeroes the frame delta and runs nothing when set.

fields.name: impl.lines_pending_reset
fields.evidence: Cleared by reset slot +0x50; set by flush (+0x98) when its bool argument is set; change_script_motion_lines takes another init path (f_71006e3190 mode 3) when set.

fields.name: impl.change_partial_immediate
fields.evidence: set_change_partial_immediate (slot +0xD0, f_71006e5380); change_script_motion_partial_lines applies the change immediately (f_71006e3810 mode 3) when set.

pointers.to: MotionAnimcmd impl block: owner boma, requested script motions, per-category lua agents and line ids, sleep flags

notes: The module itself is 16 bytes (vptr + pointer); all state lives in the 0x120-byte impl block (fields with path [0x8, off]). Fighter-class vtable slots: +0x28 init(line set), +0x50 reset agents, +0x58 exec_motion_lines, +0x60 exec partial lines, +0x68 change_script_motion_lines, +0x70 change_script_motion_partial_lines, +0x78 call_script_single, +0x80 change_script_motion_line_single, +0x88 exec_motion_lines_initialize, +0x90 flush_current_motion, +0x98 flush, +0xA0/+0xA8/+0xB0/+0xB8 set_sleep/_game/_effect/_sound, +0xC0 is_sleep, +0xC8 enable_skip_delay_update, +0xD0 set_change_partial_immediate, +0xD8 set script-lookup callback. Category order from the sleep setters: 0 game, 2 sound, 3 effect; 1 not exported (expression probable). exec_motion_lines runs categories 0/1 in the game update; flush_current_motion runs 2/3 (sound, effect) later. The agents (lua script runners, their fields +0x1C8..+0x298) are separate objects not covered here. Simulation-relevant: is_sleep, sleep[0], the main/partial motion requests, line ids and frame deltas; category 2/3 agents only drive presentation.
